countries.reasoning: China is the largest producer of aluminum oxide with extensive bauxite refining capacities, according to USGS data up to 2023; data is very reliable and recent.

India has significant bauxite reserves and alumina refineries; production figures from the Indian Ministry of Mines and USGS 2023 reports indicate consistent output; slight variation possible due to reporting lag.
Russia has several alumina plants with steady production; information from USGS and Russian industry reports is reliable but slightly less transparent than China or India data.

Australia is a major bauxite producer; alumina refining also substantial, noted in USGS 2023 data and Australian government statistics; data is solid but some production is exported as bauxite rather than refined.
Brazil produces significant alumina primarily from bauxite mining in northern regions; data from Brazilian government and USGS 2023 is good but subject to some estimation uncertainty.
